narration.text: Data brokers told to delete, and checked. This is a chore for a Californian who sent the state's one-step deletion request in January and still finds herself on people-search sites. Read each broker's answer on the state's deletion platform: deleted, opted out, exempt, not found, or nothing yet. Athena works it across 4 portals: Mailnest, Erasepoint registry, Findwho and Lookabout. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 32 dollars and 25 cents of the 32 dollars and 25 cents there was to find. All 5 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 10 traps, and she walked past 10. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 3 hours, so she was about 95 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
